main_reference: Current user Plane233 C01, actually viewed; true open-L boundary lengths paired red/blue, no source partition. Migrated to detached span annotations to preserve the physical-paper interpretation.
migration_groups: The given 3 by 3 piece has a true three-cell left border. Red names the vertical span of that particular source orientation.
The lower-left 3 by 3 region of A has a matching exterior left span. It is the actual square-piece location in A, not a guessed L-piece corner.
The source square has a true three-cell lower border. Blue distinguishes the horizontal span and makes the source orientation comparison explicit.
The lower-left 3 by 3 region of A has a matching exterior bottom span. Compare the black-white arrangement in the marked corner to the unchanged source square; a quarter-turn remains permitted.
historical_difference: The one old tested design paired the 7-cell L-piece four-unit arms with the unsuitable top-right corner of C; preset C, finals D and A. This proposal instead compares the separate 9-cell square and its genuine lower-left location in A, targeting its necessary rotation. It replaces on-material coloring with visibly detached external span brackets to avoid transporting colored ink. Neither changing an old preset nor recoloring the old relation is involved.
limitation: Detachment is a deliberate adaptation needed by the physical-piece semantics. It is subject to parent independent review.
